reuse.why: Threads the flag through the existing getFillableCategories/fillMonth/setFixedMonthAvg helpers and keeps hasSavedTemplates and isFixedGroup for the other exclusions.

duplication.why: The hidden rule is still decided in two places (the SQL in getFillableCategories and the inline check in copyPreviousMonth), and the diff adds the flag to both rather than unifying them.

placement.why: All changes stay in budget/actions.ts where the month-wide actions and their category selection live.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions, one test and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: A single defaulted parameter on the shared selection is easy to follow; the parallel filter in copyPreviousMonth remains a second place to keep in sync.
